headline: 5.5 million families to get rice at 15 taka per kg from government
summary: The government has announced a plan to provide subsidized rice to millions of low-income families to ensure food security.
details: The Bangladesh government has announced that 5.5 million families will be provided with rice at a subsidized rate of 15 taka per kilogram.
This initiative is aimed at supporting low-income families and ensuring food security across the country.
The distribution of subsidized rice is a key part of the government's social safety net program to mitigate the impact of inflation on food prices.
The program will target the most vulnerable populations to ensure that basic food staples remain affordable for the people.

headline: 3.5 years in coma: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha dies at 47
summary: The eldest daughter of King Maha Vajiralongkorn passed away on Thursday evening after a prolonged illness and a coma lasting over three years.
details: Princess Bajrakitiyabha Mahidol, the eldest daughter of King Maha Vajiralongkorn, has passed away at the age of 47 after being in a coma for three and a half years.
According to the Bureau of the Royal Household, the Princess suffered from abdominal infections, and her condition deteriorated continuously until she passed away on Thursday evening.
The tragedy began in December 2022, when she suddenly collapsed while walking her dogs. Doctors stated she suffered a severe heart arrhythmia caused by a mycoplasma infection.
Known as 'Princess Va', she was a highly educated diplomat and lawyer, holding a law degree from Cornell University in the US and having served as the Thai ambassador to Austria.
Beyond her diplomatic roles, she worked extensively with the United Nations and advocated for the rights of women, particularly improving the living conditions of female prisoners.
Her body will be placed at the Bangkok Grand Palace for members of the royal family and the public to pay their respects, with funeral rites performed with the highest honors.
King Maha Vajiralongkorn has seven children, but has not yet named an official successor to the throne according to Thai royal succession laws.
caption:
After three and a half years in a coma, Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha has passed away at 47.

Princess Bajrakitiyabha Mahidol, the eldest daughter of King Maha Vajiralongkorn, has passed away at the age of 47 after being in a coma for three and a half years.

According to the Bureau of the Royal Household, the Princess suffered from abdominal infections, and her condition deteriorated continuously until she passed away on Thursday evening.

The tragedy began in December 2022, when she suddenly collapsed while walking her dogs. Doctors stated she suffered a severe heart arrhythmia caused by a mycoplasma infection.

Known as 'Princess Va', she was a highly educated diplomat and lawyer, holding a law degree from Cornell University in the US and having served as the Thai ambassador to Austria.

Beyond her diplomatic roles, she worked extensively with the United Nations and advocated for the rights of women, particularly improving the living conditions of female prisoners.

Her body will be placed at the Bangkok Grand Palace for members of the royal family and the public to pay their respects, with funeral rites performed with the highest honors.

King Maha Vajiralongkorn has seven children, but has not yet named an official successor to the throne according to Thai royal succession laws.
